title: Change-Order Cost Impact
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:budget type=change_order
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(cost_delta) as weekly_change by _time
| eventstats sum(cost_delta) as total_change
| sort _time
description: Adds up the cost of every mid-project change so you can see how scope creep is inflating the total.
value: Small changes add up quietly; a running total keeps you honest about what the wish-list is costing.
implementation: Ingest change orders into `index=personal`; total their cost impact over time.
visualization: Column chart of change-order cost by week with a running total.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the cost of every change you make along the way, so scope creep never surprises you at the end.
